items.title: Manuel Joseph "Moose" Zanco Interview, 1959-11-25
items.q: Well, I was playing cornet. Bruce Jones was playing clarinet. Bill Lee was playing sax. Frank Della Hussi was playing piano. J.J. Joyce, drums. Bob Ice, bass.

ctx.x: Let's get all the men in the band straight while we're talking about all that. Who was with the band when you first joined?

Well, when I first joined, well, like I said, I took Joe's play, see. Okay, I'll start from that time. Yeah. Well, I was playing cornet. Bruce Jones was playing clarinet. Bill Lee was playing sax. Frank Della Hussi was playing piano. J.J. Joyce, drums. Bob Ice, bass. But Bill has swapped from his alto to a soprano sax. He plays soprano sax now. It's pretty effective. It's got a good sound. Now then we'll get different people sitting in with us, you know. Oh, the trombonist. We got a boy by the name of Archie…
